reason: Publish BatikCraft Studio 0.9.16. Fixes a crash that made JPEG export fail every time: the export worker reassigned the target path, turning it into a local variable so the earlier read raised UnboundLocalError, which the surrounding except clause did not catch, leaving the progress dialog hanging forever. Restores a green CI pipeline, which had been failing at the lint step since before 0.9.15 and therefore skipping the test suite entirely. Adds a timezone setting for auction deadlines so local times typed by creators are sent to BatikCraftWeb with an explicit UTC offset instead of being guessed by the server. Wraps every NFT publish path in a sealed .batikcraftnft package so the marketplace can verify that an artwork image really comes from a Studio project.
